description.zh:
实例的计费方式。取值：PrePaid，目前仅支持包年包月。

默认值：PrePaid
description.en:
The billing method of the instances. Valid values: PrePaid. Only subscription is supported.

Default value: PrePaid.

description.zh:
轻量应用服务器的实例ID。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

> 同时指定`InstanceIds`和`PublicIpAddresses`参数时，必须保证对应的实例ID和公网IP属于同一台轻量应用服务器，否则返回值为空。
description.en:
The instance IDs of the simple application servers. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 instance IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

> If you specify both `InstanceIds` and `PublicIpAddresses`, the instance IDs and public IP addresses must belong to the same simple application server. Otherwise, an empty result is returned.

description.zh: 轻量应用服务器实例名称，支持使用通配符*进行模糊搜索。
description.en: The name of the simple application server instance. Wildcard character (*) is supported for fuzzy match.

description.zh:
轻量应用服务器列表的页码。

默认值：1
description.en:
The page number of the simple application server list.

Default value: 1

description.zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：100

默认值：10
description.en:
The number of entries per page for paging. Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10

description.zh:
套餐类型，可能值：

- NORMAL：通用型。
- CAPACITY：容量型。
- PREVIOUS：上一代。
- MULTI_IP：多公网IP型。
- INTERNATIONAL：国际型。

> 更多信息，请参见[实例规格族](~~2861773~~)。
description.en:
The plan type. Valid values:

- NORMAL: general-purpose.
- CAPACITY: storage-optimized.
- PREVIOUS: previous generation.
- MULTI_IP: multiple public IP addresses.
- INTERNATIONAL: international.

> For more information, see [Instance family](~~2861773~~).

description.zh:
轻量应用服务器的公网IP。取值可以由多个公网ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

> 同时指定`InstanceIds`和`PublicIpAddresses`参数时，必须保证对应的实例ID和公网IP属于同一台轻量应用服务器，否则返回值为空。
description.en:
The public IP addresses of the simple application servers. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 public IP addresses. Separate multiple addresses with commas (,).

> If you specify both `InstanceIds` and `PublicIpAddresses`, the instance IDs and public IP addresses must belong to the same simple application server. Otherwise, an empty result is returned.

description.zh: 轻量应用服务器所属的地域ID。
description.en: The region ID of the simple application servers.

description.zh: 轻量应用服务器所属的资源组ID。
description.en: The resource group ID of the simple application servers.

description.zh:
实例状态，可能值：

- Pending：准备中。
- Starting：启动中。
- Running：运行中。
- Stopping：停止中。
- Stopped：停止。
- Resetting：重置中。
- Upgrading：升级中。
- Disabled：不可用。
description.en:
The instance status. Valid values:

- Pending: being prepared.
- Starting: starting.
- Running: running.
- Stopping: stopping.
- Stopped: stopped.
- Resetting: being reset.
- Upgrading: being upgraded.
- Disabled: unavailable.

description.zh: 实例的标签键。标签键长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20。
description.en: The tag key of the instance. The tag key must be 1 to 64 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

description.zh: 实例的标签值。标签值长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20。
description.en: The tag value of the instance. The tag value must be 1 to 64 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

descriptions.zh: 通过此接口可查看指定地域下一个或多个实例的详细信息，包括服务器名称、公网IP地址，内网IP地址，服务器创建时间、服务器到期时间等信息。
descriptions.en: Queries the details of one or more simple application server instances in a specified region, including the server name, public IP address, private IP address, creation time, and expiration time.
